professionalService.problemSolved: Helps an architect explain how a section drawing relates to occupied rooms, vertical movement and the garden-facing exterior of the same house.
professionalService.serviceOutcome: A technical section gains depth and material, the viewer follows a continuous route through upper, entrance and garden levels, then returns to the original sheet.
professionalService.decisionValue: Supports discussion of spatial organization and the relationship between a drawing and lived rooms. The authored house, furniture, sun dates and CTA are donor-specific claims, not transferable Rubik project facts.
